faults.title: Corrosion near rear number plate
faults.description: On the Mk3 Yaris, inspect the bodywork around the rear number plate for rust. If corrosion has started, have the affected area assessed and repaired before it spreads.

faults.title: Intermittent petrol-engine misfire
faults.description: Some petrol Mk3 Yaris cars have been reported to misfire and then run normally after a restart. Record when it happens and have the ignition and engine controls checked if it recurs.
